name: allo
description: Connect Allo's AI phone system to ChatGPT so businesses can manage conversations, contacts, team activity, call routing, AI agents, calendars, and analytics.

interface.longDescription: Connect Allo's AI phone system to ChatGPT. Search and manage conversations, SMS, contacts, notes, tags, team comments, analytics, dialing queues, call routing, summary templates, AI agents, and calendars using the permissions of your connected Allo account.
defaultPrompt: Use Allo to find and summarize recent customer conversations.
Use Allo to review our team's call and outbound analytics.
Use Allo to manage notes, tags, and follow-ups for a customer.
